posts.title: StoryWalk at Lake Wilderness Arboretum
posts.headline: Bellevue · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 沿步道边走边读，体验StoryWalk的户外阅读乐趣。精选绘本《The Girl with Big, Big Questions》鼓励孩子拥抱好奇心，用提问开启新学期。
posts.description: The Lake Wilderness Arboretum and Maple Valley Library have partnered together to bring a StoryWalk to Maple Valley. StoryWalk is an innovative approach to encouraging people of all ages to get out and walk while enjoying wonderful children’s books. With her wealth of experience, Sharon Chastain, the children’s librarian at the Maple Valley Library, selects the best children’s books for this story walk project. Then the pages are installed in frames along the Arboretum’s Main Looping Trail so as September StoryWalk: This month’s StoryWalk selection, The Girl with Big, Big Questions written by Britney Winn Lee, is a lively picture book about a persistent girl and her quest for knowledge. It celebrates the spirit of curiousity and shows us that asking questions is how we learn and grow – perhaps the perfect book to read as a new school year starts. So get outside, go for a walk, and read a book.

posts.title: Storywalk at Alderwood Park: César’s Cerulean Surprise
posts.headline: Tacoma · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 边走边读《César’s Cerulean Surprise》，跟着兄妹用“是/否”提问探寻神秘的天蓝色。故事融入西语词汇与巧妙数学思维，贴合真实手足互动。附作者说明与亲子互动小贴士，帮你把阅读变成生活里的数学游戏。
posts.description: Walk along and read the Storywalk at Alderwood Park during the park’s open hours. The September/October title is César’s Cerulean Surprise by Jenny Lacika. César asks to borrow his sister Gabi’s cerulean crayon, but Gabi does not know what cerulean is and decides to identify the color by asking yes-no questions. It’s a window into an all-too-familiar sibling dynamic, a slice of life many readers can identify with. Along with the subtle math hints, both Gabi and César sprinkle in Spanish words. Further explanation can be found in an author’s note, along with interactive tips for adults, showing how to encourage the math connections during reading.

posts.description: Experience martial arts, culture and community at the 2026 Washington State Martial Arts Festival! Bring the whole family to Crossroads Park in Bellevue for a free community celebration featuring martial arts performances, cultural experiences, interactive activities, exhibitors, a kids zone, food and more. Families can watch martial arts demonstrations, meet local martial arts schools and organizations, and give kids opportunities to explore martial arts through fun, hands-on experiences. Whether your family already practices martial arts or is simply curious, everyone is welcome. The Washington State Martial Arts Festival brings together martial arts traditions, cultures and communities from across the region for a fun and welcoming day in the park. Admission is FREE and the event is open to all ages. Crossroads Park, Bellevue Free admission Family-friendly and open to all Learn more at wama-festival.org

posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.

posts.description: Get ready for fall fun at Swans Trail Farms, just 30 minutes from Seattle! Harvest Festival is open daily from 10 AM–6 PM, with U-Pick apples and pumpkins, family-friendly attractions, farm-fresh food, and plenty of fall memories to make. Don’t miss our magical pumpkin garden, a favorite spot for fall photos! Enjoy the full experience of the Harvest Festival with over 30+ farm fun attractions! Wander through the legendary Washington State Corn Maze, a 12-acre masterpiece meticulously shaped like our state. You’ll navigate 4.5 miles of paths, discovering over 700 state roads and landmarks. Afterward, warm up with our famous apple cider donuts and fresh-pressed cider, or visit our Cidery for a hard cider made with apples from our own orchard. roundup.title: 本周末亲子活动精选｜6城8场
roundup.caption:
这个周末，6 个城市都有适合家庭的活动！🌿

本周亮点包括「Mid-Autumn Festival」和「Carpinito Brothers Fall Festival」，适合安排轻松又充实的亲子时光。从户外探索到社区活动，各个城市都有值得带孩子一起体验的选择。

我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

1. Seattle：Mid-Autumn Festival
   Seattle Chinese Garden
   趋势关键词：fall festival、Mid-Autumn Moon Festival
   亮点：中秋庆典有文化表演和趣味活动，亲子同乐。

2. Seattle：Carpinito Brothers Fall Festival
   Carpinito Brothers Farm
   趋势关键词：fall festival
   亮点：南瓜满地、挑战玉米迷宫，雷尼尔山作背景随手都是大片。

3. Bellevue：StoryWalk at Lake Wilderness Arboretum
   Lake Wilderness Arboretum
   趋势关键词：story time
   亮点：沿步道边走边读，体验StoryWalk的户外阅读乐趣。

4. Bellevue：Pumpkin Farm and Puzzle Patch
   JB Family Growers
   趋势关键词：pumpkin
   亮点：在巨型玉米迷宫里探索蜿蜒小径，尽情寻路。

5. Tacoma：Lattin’s Fall Festival
   Lattin’s Country Cider Mill and Farm
   趋势关键词：fall festival
   亮点：在南瓜田采摘南瓜，畅玩弹跳城堡和亲子游戏。

6. Kirkland：2026 Washington State Martial Arts Festival
   Crossroads Community Park
   亮点：免费入场、老少皆宜的武术文化节，欣赏武术表演、文化体验和互动活动。

7. Lynnwood：Craven Farm Fall Festival
   Craven Farm
   趋势关键词：fall festival
   亮点：🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。

8. Edmonds：Harvest Festival at Swans Trail Farms
   Swan’s Trail Farms
   趋势关键词：harvest
   亮点：🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。

收藏这份周末清单，带上家人一起出门玩吧！
